market_nexus.source: public/xrbc-market-nexus.js; existing xrbc:market-context event and exact window.XRBCChartMarket.read() pair
market_nexus.transform: XRBCCombinedLiquidity.normalizeBook/normalizePool/market/depth([.02]); funded quantities, exact pair identity, marginal-price comparison; radius relative to funded size on each displayed side and position by price in selectable ±2/5/10% range.
market_nexus.freshness: fresh===true; exact issuer/currency match; positive safe ledger index and 64-hex hash; fetched and close age <=90s, future skew <=15s. One observation per new ledger; same ledger deduped, backward/hash-conflict fails closed.
market_nexus.coverage: Up to 12 visual offers per side from at most 100 sampled offers per side. Trail holds at most 60 session observations; source change resets it. Pool-only state is explicit; unavailable book stays unknown even when AMM exists.
market_nexus.failure_state: Stale/error/crossed/pair change clear visuals and trail; no fabricated quote nodes.
market_nexus.motion: Finite 1.4s pulse only on a new ledger; Pause, reduced-motion, hidden-document and offscreen suppression. Keyboard/click SVG inspection with text equivalents.
market_nexus.network_and_wallet: No new RPC, wallet access or signing.
market_nexus.verification: 8 focused Node tests, including mounted stale/pause/repeat rendering; source/mocked evidence. Browser preview unavailable; no live-layout or wallet claim.

swap_nexus.source: public/xrbc-swap-liquidity.js; existing xrbc:market-context event.detail and exact selected pair
swap_nexus.transform: Existing evaluate() and XRBCCombinedLiquidity normalize/quote/depth logic; own offers excluded. Source SVG width/opacity derives from source.baseAmount / quote.filledBase, representing modeled fill only.
swap_nexus.freshness: Existing 90-second maximum age and exact hash/index/time/pair validation remain unchanged.
swap_nexus.coverage: Direct-pair AMM/book model only. Unknown source says Unavailable; one known source can produce an explicitly labeled Pool-only or Book-only model. Alternative directions/bands use the same underlying liquidity.
swap_nexus.failure_state: Stale/error/zero fill hides flow and pauses motion; unavailable is not zero.
swap_nexus.motion: Illustrative flow, not executed trades/volume; accessible text; Pause, prefers-reduced-motion, document-hidden and IntersectionObserver offscreen suppression.
swap_nexus.transaction_boundary: No new network/payload/signing. Deliberate combined-use only stages through existing XRBCSwapTicket.stage; existing review obtains a fresh execution quote.
swap_nexus.verification: 6 focused module tests including pause/unknown-source assertions; no signed wallet or live layout claim.
